overview.description: The T. Rowe Price Dividend Growth ETF (TDVG) is an exchange-traded fund. The fund's investment portfolio concentrates primarily on total market equity. TDVG is an actively-managed, non-transparent fund of global, large- and mid-cap companies with sustainable, above-average growth in earnings and dividends TDVG was launched on Aug 4, 2020 and is issued by T. Rowe Price.
